evidence.claim: According to official regulatory records tracked on Tofler, Automaton AI Infosystem Private Limited reported an operating revenue range of INR 1 cr - 100 cr for the financial year ending on March 31, 2023.

Revenue Growth & Funding.assessed_on: The review verified the company's baseline seed round funding amount, participating investor, and its statutory operating revenue range through independent financial aggregators, but based on primary research, the company has not disclosed specific ongoing revenue growth rates or net profitability figures.

evidence.claim: Great Place to Work® certified the company as having an expert-led R&D team with a total company headcount of approximately 20 employees based in India.

Entrepreneur India documented that the company was founded by serial entrepreneur Paras Jain, partnered with the Ministry of Science & Technology, and received government backing to build drone manufacturing capabilities under the Make in India initiative.

Talent & Ecosystem.assessed_on: While we verified its core founder, general R&D presence, and government ecosystem partnerships with the Ministry of Science & Technology, based on primary research, the company has not disclosed the explicit size/quality of the sales team or specific collaborations with IITs or DRDO, keeping the score within the present but partial capability band.
